title: おにぎりとお弁当
subject_en: Cute lunch-box foods, each a single separate item with a tiny simple face on it where natural: onigiri rice balls, side dishes, bento boxes, a thermos. Food items only, no people. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text.
lead: おにぎり、おかずいろいろ、お弁当箱、水筒。遠足、ピクニック、毎日のお弁当に使える食べものイラスト12点。
